caption: The drawing depicts two wooden figures of men positioned on opposite sides of a large horizontal log, both gripping the handles of a long, serrated saw that is placed on top of the log. The man on the left has short dark hair, a dark brown shirt, and red pants, and stands on a rectangular brown base designed to look like rough ground. The man on the right has light-colored hair, a dark shirt, and green pants, also standing on a similar brown base. The large log in the center is textured and colored to resemble bark, mainly in shades of gray and brown with visible rings on its cut end. The background is plain and beige, with no additional elements or scenery. The composition is centered on the log and saw, with the two figures facing each other.
title: Lumberjacks Sawing a Log
